run_train_data_loader: run the train_data_loader to batch and augment ScanNet training point cloud data with elastic deformation
run_val_data_loader: run the val_data_loader to batch and transform ScanNet validation point cloud data with random flips and rotations
build_trainMerge_collate: build a trainMerge collate function that applies random rotation, scaling, elastic deformation, and offset to training point clouds
build_valMerge_collate: build a valMerge collate function that applies random flip, rotation, scaling, and offset to validation point clouds
create_elastic_distortion: create elastic distortion noise to augment 3D point cloud coordinates with convolved random displacement fields
